howto.name: Upload files
howto.text: Drop multiple files of any type, up to 500 MB per file.

howto.name: Choose compression level
howto.text: Use Store for speed, Balanced for everyday ZIPs, or Maximum for the smallest output.

howto.name: Download the ZIP
howto.text: All files are bundled into a single .zip with their original filenames and extensions.

faq.a: Not yet. Create ZIP produces standard, unencrypted ZIP archives; password-protected archives are not supported.
Uploaded files are placed at the root of the archive. To preserve a folder structure, upload them folder-by-folder using the multi-folder option.

faq.q: What compression level should I choose?
faq.a: Balanced is best for most files. Store is fastest for already-compressed files like JPG, MP4, and PDF. Maximum can shrink text-heavy files more but takes longer.
